summary: Today's pick in America is wait for now (if buying anyway, their favourite is CCC). Today's pick in India is buy TECHM. Analysts are discussing that CCC is a low-priced stock with recent volume surge but a long-term declining trend, making it unlikely to deliver big gains. They also note that TECHM is at an all-time high due to currency tailwinds but has only steady historical growth, far from what is needed to multiply money tenfold in a short time.
